1  NC: 2024:KHC-K:3778  MFA No. 200906 of 2022 MODIFYING THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 11.08.2021 PASSED BY THE COURT OF IV ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MEMBER MACT-XV, VIJAYAPURA IN MVC NO.1616/2016.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
This is claimant's appeal for enhancement of compensation awarded by IV Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and Member, MACT-XV, Vijayapura (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal' for short) in MVC No.1616/2016 dated 11.08.2021.
Though this appeal is listed for admission, with the consent of both the side, it is taken up for final disposal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as per their ranks before the Tribunal.

3. It is the case of the claimant/appellant that on 05.09.2015 while he was going on his motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-29-8624, he met with an accident at Toravi village, on Vijayapura-Takota Road due to rash and NC: 2024:KHC-K:3778 negligent driving of lorry bearing Reg.No.KA-29-5884 by its driver.
As a result of which petitioner had sustained grievous injuries.
With these reasons, the claimant prayed to award compensation of Rs.10,00,000/-.
4. Respondent No.2/insurer denied contents of the claim petition and prayed for dismissal of the claim petition.
5. From the rival contentions of both the parties, the Tribunal had framed the necessary issues for its determination.
6. The claimant to prove his case examined PW-1 and got marked Exs.P1 to 7 and closed his evidence.

Respondent No.2 has examined RW-1.
7.

After hearing both the parties and appreciating the evidence available on record, the Tribunal by its impugned judgment and award dated 11.08.2021, awarded compensation of Rs.25,000/- the same is challenged in the present appeal.

2 8. Heard arguments of learned counsel for the appellant and respondent No.2.
9.
The learned counsel for the appellant submits that Ex.P.7 was not at all considered by the Tribunal, and claimant had sustained a fracture of clavicular bone.
He had taken treatment nearly for 20 days in a government hospital as well as in a private hospital.
He has spent huge amount on treatment, but it was not considered by the Tribunal.
Therefore, prayed for enhancement of compensation.
10. The learned counsel for respondent No.2 vehemently contends that the Tribunal after appreciation of Exs.P6 and 7, considered the injury of the claimant as three simple injuries.
Ex.P6 shows that the claimant had not sustained any fracture or dislocating of bones.
Therefore, nearly he had taken treatment for some days in the hospital cannot be presumed that claimant had sustained fractures.
The tribunal has awarded just amount of compensation and does not call for interference.
The following question arises for determination.
"Whether the claimant is entitled for the enhancement of compensation?
12. The Facts of accident, injury sustained by the claimant in a vehicle accident are not in dispute and there is no need to reconsider the same.
13. In the impugned judgment at paragraph No.15, the tribunal did not give any reasons regarding reference about nature of injuries mentioned in Ex.P7.
The claimant was admitted in the Al-Nabi Medico Surgical Hospital from 05.10.2015 to 15.10.2015.
Ex.P6 shows that claimant was admitted in District hospital Vijayapura from 05.09.2015 to 14.09.2015.
If he had sustained only three simple injuries, as held by the Trial Court, then there was no question of admitting a patient for nearly 21 days in the hospital, for treatment.
14. The Tribunal has not considered awarding of compensation towards attendance charges, special diet, conveyance charges etc.

The amount of compensation NC: 2024:KHC-K:3778 Rs.25,000/-
awarded is only on the basis of injuries sustained by claimant, which were simple in nature.
It clearly indicates non application of mind regarding Ex.P7.
The submission of learned counsel for appellant is accepted.
15. It may not be probable that for treatment of a simple injuries, the patient would be admitted for nearly 20 days in two different hospitals.
Though injuries are shown as simple in nature it might have same complications.
Therefore, the amount of compensation awarded by the tribunal is on lower side.

Considering Exs.P6 and 7, admission of claimant for more than 20 days in the hospital,
the amount spent towards incidental expenses etc., claimant is entitled for Additional Global Compensation of Rs.20,000/- over and above the amount awarded by the Tribunal.

Accordingly, this Court pass the following order:

3 ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed in part.
ii. The impugned judgment and award passed by the IV Addl.
